commands.review_summary:
This PR hardens `/status` rendering by replacing two status runtime wrappers with direct imports, retrying remaining status dynamic loaders after rejection, adding a 10s fallback around `buildStatusReply`, updating focused status tests, and removing a stale built-status-runtime script.

PR surface: Source +48, Tests +91, Config -1, Other -85. Total +53 across 10 files.

Reproducibility: yes. for a source-level path: current main can reject while building `/status` before a reply payload exists, and this PR adds tests for timeout and retry-cache paths. I did not reproduce the intermittent LINE failure live in this read-only review.

target.title: fix(status): LINE /status intermittent no-response — fallback, timeout, and retry hardening
target.body:
## Summary

Fixes LINE `/status` intermittently returning no response by hardening the dynamic module loaders, adding a safety-net timeout with fallback message, and cleaning up stale status runtime build checks.

### Changes (10 files, +221/-168)

#### Core Status Fixes

| Phase | What | Rationale |
|:------|:-----|:---------|
| **Phase 0+1** | `.catch(() => undefined)` fallbacks on all 4 dynamic runtime loaders | Previously, a transient import failure would propagate uncaught — now each loader returns sensible defaults instead of throwing |
| **Phase 2** | Eliminate 2 fragile dynamic-import wrappers (`status-message.runtime.ts`, `status-queue.runtime.ts`) via precise static imports; fix rejected cached promises on remaining 3 loaders by resetting promise to `null` on reject | Static imports eliminate the dynamic-hop failure point; promise reset removes the permanent-cache poison so transient failures are retried |
| **Phase 2 fix** | Replace `?? {} as any` false-positive in plugin health line with proper early-return guard | Previously a loader failure would show "🔌Plugins: OK" instead of "🔌 Plugins: health unavailable" |
| **Phase 3** | Add 10s `setTimeout` race in `buildStatusReply` returning a user-visible fallback message | Without the timeout, a hanging render produces zero response to the user |
| **ClawSweeper fixes** | Revert `warn` → `logVerbose` in `logLineHttpError` (P1); remove proof scripts (P1, behavior covered by unit tests); remove stale `createLazyPromise`/`createLazyRuntimeModule` imports (P1, caused check-lint + check-prod-types CI failures); remove dead `clearTimeout(timer)` inside setTimeout callback | `warn` is a theme formatter, not a logger; stale imports were rebase artifact; `clearTimeout` was no-op (timer already fired) |

#### Cleanup

| File | Change |
|:-----|:-------|
| `scripts/test-built-status-message-runtime.mjs` + `test/scripts/...test.ts` | Delete stale runtime build checks (superseded by proper unit tests) |
| `package.json` | Remove `test-built-status-message-runtime` script entry |

#### Tests

| Suite | Tests | Coverage |
|:------|:------|:---------|
| `commands-status.test.ts` | 38 | Timeout path (new), throw path, and all existing scenarios |
| `status-text.test.ts` | 6 | Same-module dynamic loader retry cache (new), channel features, plugin health fallback |

### Scope

This PR targets the specific `/status` no-response failure path only. Broader LINE delivery hardening (reply-token management, push-fallback enhancements) is tracked in a separate open issue: openclaw/openclaw#86012.

### Closes

Closes openclaw/openclaw#94626

---

### Types of Changes

- [x] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation (non-code change that improves documentation)
- [ ] 🔧 Chore (refactoring, test updates, CI configuration changes)

---

## What Problem This Solves

LINE `/status` command intermittently returned no response when dynamic imports through cached promise loaders suffered a transient failure — the rejected promise was cached permanently, causing every subsequent `/status` attempt to reuse the failed loader state. Additionally, the timeout safety net was missing entirely: if any segment of the status rendering stalled, the user received zero response.

---

## Evidence

**Real environment tested:**
- **OS:** Windows 11 24H2
- **Runtime:** Node.js v24.14.1
- **Branch:** `fix/line-94626-status` (rebased onto upstream/main `9606fe4323`)
- **Local head before push:** `a2d83ae5d9`

### Unit test proof

- Prior PR head CI passed the focused status suites and full GitHub checks at `6b7e83d9` before the latest rebase.
- Post-rebase reviewer/test-engineer inspection confirmed `src/status/status-text.test.ts` now proves same-module retry: one `vi.resetModules()` before importing `buildStatusText`, then failure and success both use the same imported function with no module reset between attempts.
- `git diff --check -- src/status/status-text.test.ts` — pass
- `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` — pass
- Post-push CI for `a2d83ae5d9` is pending; the previous `check-lint` failure on `ccd5a681ba` was traced to an unused static test import and fixed by `a2d83ae5d9`.

### Known CI caveats

- Local focused Vitest could not be rerun in the clean Windows worktree because dependencies were intentionally not installed there; the separate dependency-hydrated worktree had broken workspace links and was abandoned before push.
- Testbox/Crabbox proof could not be dispatched from this machine because `crabbox` failed wrapper sanity checks and `blacksmith` was unavailable on PATH.
- GitHub CI is expected to provide the post-push runnable proof for the rebased head.

### What this proof covers vs. what it does not

| Aspect | Covered | Not covered |
|:-------|:--------|:------------|
| Timeout fallback path | ✅ Integration test through `buildStatusReply` with mocked hanging `buildStatusText` | ❌ Not triggered through a real LINE `/status` command with a genuine hanging import |
| Dynamic loader retry cache | ✅ Unit test proves the same imported `status-text.ts` module falls back on import failure and retries successfully on the next render | ❌ Not triggered through a real LINE session |
| Normal `/status` rendering | ✅ LINE screenshots in PR history show working `/status` output | — |

### Limitations

The patched timeout/retry fallback was not triggered through a live LINE bot conversation because triggering the genuine failure condition (a transient dynamic import rejection) is environment-dependent and not reproducible on demand. The timeout path is exercised at the integration test level, and the retry path is exercised at the unit test level.

### Maintainer decision required

This PR adds a **10 second timeout** to every `buildStatusReply` caller. A status render that is slow but would eventually succeed will instead return fallback text after 10 seconds. Maintainers should confirm this behavior is acceptable before merging.

---

## Review status

- ✅ Code review: CONDITIONALLY APPROVED (stale imports + dead clearTimeout fixed; post-rebase retry assertion corrected; lint import cleanup reviewed)
- ✅ Test coverage: PASS by existing focused tests; post-rebase GitHub CI pending for new head
- ⏳ ClawSweeper review: pending re-review after push
- ✅ Rebased onto upstream/main (`9606fe4323`) — clean rebase
